entries.notes: All 30 TypeScript declarations are translated directly. Coverage preserves mechanism-based sequence buckets, chunk-count-independent progress bins, sparse input handling, exact mean-profile and histogram merges, doubling size bins, nearest-rank percentiles, one-decimal rounding, per-run delay maxima, steady-window rate trimming, skew-free CDV with duplicate/reorder/hole accounting, positive-CDV sequence padding, count-weighted averages, and percentile-of-percentiles aggregation. Final GREEN must share one production Rust implementation between the deployment reader and benchmark runner; fixture tables or precomputed summaries are insufficient.
